items.title: JPMorgan Chase (JPM) Sees 40% Jump In Asia Pacific Alternative Asset Allocations
items.summary: JPMorgan Chase (NYSE:JPM) reports a sharp rise in ultra-wealthy client demand for alternative investments tied to infrastructure themes. The bank highlights a tilt toward assets linked to AI data centers, power grid upgrades, electrification and energy security projects. Within its Asia-Pacific wealth franchise, allocations to alternative assets are reported to be 40% higher, focused on these long-term themes. items.summary: Allison Beer, the CEO of card and connected commerce, “has informed me of her decision to leave the firm for an external opportunity,” JPMorgan Co-President Troy Rohrbaugh said in a memo on Friday.

items.title: Amodei Highlights Computing Power, Capex Dilemma Ahead Of Anthropic IPO

items.title: Anthropic Chief Says He Hopes IPO Will ‘Underpromise and Overdeliver’
